title: State that SIID never establishes signer identity before signature verification
description: Security review found contradictory identity wording in draft-lichen-link-01 §3.4: after correctly calling SIID an unauthenticated candidate-selection hint, it says the immediate link identity is established by the Signer Identifier 'and' subsequent signature verification. An 8-byte SIID is a collision-prone alias and must never establish any part of authenticated identity; only successful verification under a current full trust-store public key/generation does. Rewrite the sentence and examples so SIID solely selects a bounded candidate set, collision sets retain all candidates/fail closed on capacity, and no trust/routing/replay/fragmentation state is keyed or authorized by SIID.
